subject: Porch hang this Sunday?
text:
Hey, just checking back since I stopped by two days ago and didn’t want to miss you! I’m planning a tiny study break on the porch Sunday, with popcorn and maybe some board games. It’ll be chill. If you’re free and want a break from errands, I’d love for you to swing by. No pressure, just say the word if it sounds fun. I’ll save a comfy chair.

Talk soon,
